name: Taumako Parangaina tepuke
description: A Taumako-built sailing canoe with a hollowed log hull and pandanus sail.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: Parangaina was launched at Taumako after William Keizy led its construction with advice from family and community elders.

evidence.supports: Museum identifies William Keizy as the community-led builder of Parangaina, launched at Taumako in 1997 after consultation with elders; describes the dugout hull, pandanus sail, historical trade and 1997 museum purchase.

events.caveats: The 1997 vessel is a documented local recovery effort, not the origin of the tepuke.
